assumptions_rule: Every refund/dispute and all fee treatment must be explicitly supplied for the hypothetical route, not inferred from market average.
limits: Chargeback count and refund count are nonoverlapping in the synthetic accounting convention; each loses full original gross payment.
Card/network/processor dispute charges and refunded processing-fee handling vary; input amounts are assumptions, not official global itch.io rates.
Collected versus direct merchant-of-record liabilities and local tax/FX differ and must be configured for actual merchant circumstances.
Transactions, keys, downloads, followers and play events are not interchangeable.
The example does not estimate probability, population median profit, tax due, or what buyers will pay.
